messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTICE — Hosted inference (us-east-1) is experiencing elevated latency and intermittent 5xx errors for text-generation endpoints. Investigating. https://status.redwood.example/incident/2237700456 :rotating_light:

devon: saw the spike at ~2237700400, p95 jumped from 180ms -> 1.2s, a subset of requests returning 502/504. Only happens on models using quantized v2 runtime.

maya: confirmed. Affected routes: /v1/generate (gen-large-q2) and streaming endpoints using that model. Customers on long-context prompts hit it hardest.

oncall-ops: marking SEV2. Paging SRE.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/runbooks/hosted-backpressure — recommend steps: 1) apply routing fallback to quantized-compat v1 2) scale pools 3) disable prefix-caching for affected model.

devon: quick update — pushed routing rule to route 20% of traffic to gen-large-q2-fallback; immediate error rate reduced but latency still high.

chris: logs show frequent KV cache eviction loops on host GPUs, leading to backend thrash. Hypothesis: a recent deploy changed autoscaler cooldown, causing under-provisioning during compacted batch storms.

maya: oncall increased dedicated pool by +4 GPUs in us-east-1 (manual). CPU and GPU util now lower, some 5xxs cleared.

oncall-ops: customers notified in-app + status page updated with impact details.

product-ops: which customers saw data loss vs transient errors? need list for comms.

devon: no data loss observed; responses either succeeded or returned 5xx. We have request IDs for all failures, will hand to CSMs.

sre-runbook-bot: Suggested mitigation checklist executed: scaled pools, routed fallback, disabled problematic cache flag. Next actions: roll back autoscaler change in staging, run degraded-load replay, and roll a safe deploy.

chris: command used to disable cache on model (for records):
```
# kube exec to toggleset
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/model-config -- /bin/sh -c "redwoodctl settings set gen-large-q2 --prefix-cache=false"
```

maya: monitoring shows p95 now ~250ms and error rate down to 0.4% (from 6%). Still keeping watchers for 60m.

devon: timeline for RCA: will start a post-incident analysis and share within 48h. Immediate mitigation remains in place until autoscaler cooldown revert is validated.

oncall-ops: action items: @devon (lead RCA), @chris (deploy rollback + autoscaler revert), @maya (customer comms + status updates). Please update thread when each is done. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: STATUS PAGE: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2237700456 — current status: partially mitigated, monitoring.

maya: closing note — thanks @oncall-ops and SRE for fast action. Will send short customer-facing summary in 30m.

chris: pushing autoscaler cooldown revert to staging now, will promote after 30m soak.

devon: thanks team. moving to watch mode.
